driverChangesNeeded.why: The nav change breaks how the nav states are reached: without a case in planState the three new IDs fall to the default (full-page index capture at all four viewports), and the two retired cases reference .appnav-toggle, which no longer exists.
changes: planState: add frame.nav-bar (applicable only when viewport < 600), frame.nav-rail (600 <= viewport < 1024) and frame.nav-inline (viewport >= 1024); otherwise not-applicable with reason 'nav class <bar|rail|inline> exists only at <range> (DESIGN.md D-8)'. Suggested region: element crop of the nav (new UiRole 'appnav': prototype '.appnav', app '[data-testid=km-appnav]'), so the cell isolates the nav from page content.

planState: delete the frame.nav-collapsed and frame.nav-open cases and the 'nav-toggle' UiRole / PROTOTYPE_SELECTORS entry; NAV_ONLY_BELOW and CAPTURE_ENVIRONMENT.navCollapseMaxWidth (899) are obsolete. Replace with the window tokens (windowMedium 600, windowExpanded 1024) if a constant is still wanted; changing CAPTURE_ENVIRONMENT is fine because every baseline is recaptured anyway.

Full-page captures: Chromium renders the position:fixed bar (375) and rail (768) at their first-viewport position, so in long full-page captures the bar sits over content at y = viewport height - 64 and the rail stops at the first viewport height. The app frame uses the same fixed geometry, so reference and app match; no change required, but either keep full-page for both or switch frame-bearing pages at 375/768 to viewport captures for both, never one of each.

Unchanged and still valid: frame.appbar-signed-out/in crop to #appbar (the fixed bar/rail is outside its box), frame.account-menu-open (.acct-btn), frame.theme-toggle (.theme-toggle), frame.skip-link-focused (Tab). processingPin.purpose: recordings.processing.* is timer-driven (5 pipeline steps, 1.3-2.0 s each, 400 ms start delay); a capture taken at any wall-clock moment differs. The prototype now freezes it deterministically (RV-36).
processingPin.prototype: Load docs/design/prototype/recordings.html?km-processing-pin=N#processing:<id>. The query parameter must come before the hash. Equivalent: set html[data-km-processing-pin=N] before the script runs (addInitScript on document.documentElement).
processingPin.values: N is an integer 0..5. N steps are Done/Pinned, step N is In progress at 50% with a static (non-spinning) icon, later steps are Waiting; N=5 is the finished state (all done, 'Recording ready' note, meter 100%). No timers, no toast.
processingPin.suggestedPinReason: 2 shows done, in-progress and waiting rows in one frame. Use one value for every viewport/theme; do not capture without the pin.
processingPin.driverChange: state-drivers.ts is bdd-quality's: for entry.id starting 'recordings.processing.' append '?km-processing-pin=2' to the prototype URL (target.urlFor) before the hash. The app's processing view must read the same query parameter and render the same frozen frame (request to ui-engineer); until it does, app cells for this state stay non-deterministic.
processingPin.recaptureNeeded: recordings.processing.partner-onboarding-1014 for all 8 theme x viewport cells, prototype and app.
